mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALE' THEN d.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALE' THEN d.amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'REFUND' THEN d.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'REFUND' THEN d.amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM ( SELECT DATE(o.pay_time) AS stat_date, 'SALE' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(t.price) AS amt FROM ticket t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(o.pay_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(rf.refund_time), 'REFUND', COUNT(*), SUM(rf.refund_amount) FROM refund rf WHERE rf.refund_time >= #{start} AND rf.refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rf.biz_type = 'REFUND' GROUP BY DATE(rf.refund_time) ) d GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date

SELECT d.period, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALE' THEN d.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALE' THEN d.amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'REFUND' THEN d.cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'REFUND' THEN d.amt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM ( SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%x-W%v') DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period, 'SALE' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(t.price) AS amt FROM ticket t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY period UNION ALL SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(rf.refund_time, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(rf.refund_time, '%x-W%v') DATE_FORMAT(rf.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period, 'REFUND', COUNT(*), SUM(rf.refund_amount) FROM refund rf WHERE rf.refund_time >= #{start} AND rf.refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND rf.biz_type = 'REFUND' GROUP BY period ) d GROUP BY d.period ORDER BY d.period

SELECT r.route_name AS routeName, COUNT(t.id) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS saleAmount FROM ticket t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.id JOIN schedule s ON t.schedule_id = s.id JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id WHERE t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.route_name ORDER BY saleCount DESC

SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, r.route_name AS routeName, DATE_FORMAT(s.depart_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS departTime, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') THEN t.price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income FROM schedule s JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED', 'REFUNDED') WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND s.depart_time >= #{start} AND s.depart_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY s.id, r.route_name, s.depart_time HAVING saleCount > 0 OR refundCount > 0 ORDER BY s.depart_time

SELECT u.id AS sellerId, u.name AS sellerName, COUNT(t.id) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS saleAmount FROM user u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.seller_id = u.id AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.order_id = o.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE u.role = 'SELLER' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY saleCount DESC

SELECT u.id AS sellerId, u.name AS sellerName, COUNT(t.id) AS saleCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS saleAmount FROM user u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.seller_id = u.id AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.order_id = o.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE u.id = #{sellerId} GROUP BY u.id, u.name

SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, r.route_name AS routeName, DATE_FORMAT(s.depart_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS departTime, sh.ship_name AS shipName, sh.total_seats AS totalSeats, COUNT(t.id) AS soldCount, ROUND(COUNT(t.id) / sh.total_seats * 100, 2) AS occupancy FROM schedule s JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY s.id, r.route_name, s.depart_time, sh.ship_name, sh.total_seats ORDER BY occupancy DESC

SELECT r.route_name, ROUND(AVG(x.occ), 2) AS avgOccupancy FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.route_id, COUNT(t.id) / sh.total_seats * 100 AS occ FROM schedule s JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY s.id, s.route_id, sh.total_seats ) x JOIN route r ON x.route_id = r.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id, r.route_name ORDER BY avgOccupancy DESC

SELECT x.period, ROUND(AVG(x.occ), 2) AS avgOccupancy, COUNT(*) AS scheduleCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(s.depart_time) < 12 THEN '早班(06-12)' WHEN HOUR(s.depart_time) < 18 THEN '午班(12-18)' ELSE '晚班(18-24)' END AS period, COUNT(t.id) / sh.total_seats * 100 AS occ FROM schedule s JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY s.id, s.depart_time, sh.total_seats ) x GROUP BY x.period ORDER BY x.period

SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, r.route_name AS routeName, DATE_FORMAT(s.depart_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS departTime, sh.total_seats AS totalSeats, COUNT(t.id) AS soldCount, ROUND(COUNT(t.id) / sh.total_seats * 100, 2) AS occupancy FROM schedule s JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id AND t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status IN ('SELLING', 'DEPARTED') GROUP BY s.id, r.route_name, s.depart_time, sh.total_seats HAVING occupancy < #{threshold} ORDER BY occupancy, departTime

SELECT s.total_income AS totalIncome, s.sale_count AS saleCount, r.refund_loss AS refundLoss, r.refund_count AS refundCount, r.refund_fee AS refundFee, (s.total_income - r.refund_loss) AS netIncome, CASE WHEN s.sale_count + r.refund_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(r.refund_count / (s.sale_count + r.refund_count) * 100, 2) END AS refundRate FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS total_income, COUNT(*) AS sale_count FROM ticket t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE t.status IN ('PAID', 'CHECKED') AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) s, ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refund_loss, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(fee), 0) AS refund_fee FROM refund WHERE refund_time >= #{start} AND refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND biz_type = 'REFUND' ) r

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(reason, ''), '未填写') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS refundCount, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, COALESCE(SUM(fee), 0) AS feeAmount FROM refund WHERE refund_time >= #{start} AND refund_time < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND biz_type = 'REFUND' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(reason, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY refundCount DESC
